pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

2. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

3. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

4. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 169
   D. 26

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

6. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

7. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 17
   C. 13
   D. 15

9. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 13
   C. 1
   D. 7

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

11. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 1, 6

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 5

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 24

16. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

17. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 24.5
   C. 7
   D. 8

18. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 48
   D. 49

19. Solve for x: x + 4 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 12
   D. 4

20. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 14

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 105
   B. 22
   C. 44
   D. 30

22. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

23. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 11

24. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 33

25. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

26. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 77
   C. 36
   D. 18

27. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 12

28. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 1
   D. 20

29. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

30. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24
